sources.title: Qwen3-4B Mathematical Reasoning Fine-Tuning - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a sophisticated fine-tuning pipeline that transforms Alibaba's Qwen3-4B into a mathematically-enhanced reasoning model. By leveraging Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and 4-bit quantization, we achieve optimal performance while maintaining memory efficiency for consumer hardware.

sources.title: qwen3:4b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: The Qwen 3 family is a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. The flagship model, Qwen3-235B-A22B, achieves competitive results in benchmark evaluations of coding, math, general capabilities, etc., when compared to other top-tier models such as DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3, and Gemini-2.5-Pro.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
